title: REQ · Countdown and Round status badge show the current Round
summary: Countdown with time left plus status badge from /round/current
description: Context: the API serves {id,number,status,starts_at,ends_at}. Desired behavior: a Countdown component ticking each second to ends_at showing HH:MM:SS, 'Round closed' at zero, and a RoundBadge showing status text; App fetches the Round on mount. Why: players know when ideas close.
acceptance_criteria: Given ends_at 90 seconds ahead, then the countdown shows 00:01:30 and after 1 second 00:01:29
Given ends_at in the past, then it shows 'Round closed'
Given status OPEN, then the badge shows OPEN
Given the Round fetch fails, then the badge shows 'Round unavailable'
technical_constraints: Clock injectable via now prop for tests
definition_of_done: Badge and countdown visible in playing view
